_meta.purpose: OSS Maintainers Slice 4 — calibration fixture for the maintainership classifier. Per spec §13.1, this fixture gates Slice 4 ship via three agreement-rate thresholds (exact-level >= 0.80, within-one-level >= 0.95, non-adjacent confusion <= 0.02). Sam (or a designated human reviewer) hand-classifies each entry by reading the actual GitHub profile and cross-checking merged PRs / CONTRIBUTORS / GOVERNANCE files. Building the fixture is real work, not background — budget 2-5 hours for a run of 20-30 entries. No automated tooling can produce this honestly: the gate's whole purpose is to detect 'right for the wrong reason' classifier failures, which requires labels grounded in human inspection.
_meta.span_target: infrastructure (kubernetes/kubernetes, etcd-io/etcd) | systems (rust-lang/rust, torvalds/linux) | devtools (pytorch/pytorch, astral-sh/uv) | web (facebook/react, vercel/next.js)

entry_shape.evidence_notes: 1-3 sentences describing why this label, citing observable artifacts (merged PRs, CONTRIBUTORS file, GOVERNANCE.md, public role). Audited by a second human if possible.
entry_shape.classified_by: name or initials of the human classifier

_meta.status: EMPTY — awaiting hand-classification work by Sam. Slice 4 does NOT ship until this fixture has 20-30 entries AND tests/test_github_maintainership_classifier.py's agreement gate passes against it. The classifier code (github/maintainership.py) ships as scaffolding; the gate verdict is deferred until the fixture is populated.
